notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: White bollard with a black top; bright red reflector at the front and a white one at the back.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Directional signs are yellow with a black border.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Distinct km markers: road number in a yellow box at top left, another number beside it, a black line, then the distance below.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Chevrons are usually red arrows on white; a rarer version has a black arrow on white.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Pedestrian signs have five stripes and a simply drawn person with no belt.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Long dashed outer edge lines are common, which neighbours rarely use.

notes.subject: language
notes.text: Slavic language with Č, Š and Ž. One neighbour shares those letters but adds Ć and Đ.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Street signs are white with a metal border on posts, or red on house walls, and names usually contain the word ulica.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: House numbers are typically red with white text.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: Regular A-type guardrail with rounded edges; handy to tell apart from the square-edged type next door.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Kozolec: a shed of thin wooden beams with visible gaps, very typical here.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Alpine-inspired houses with light walls, dark wooden details and semi-steep half-hipped roofs.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Very hilly and forested, and much coverage is on small roads deep in the woods.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The tallest mountains are in the alpine northwest.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Flat or rolling farmland with no mountains in view marks the east.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Near the coast: white cliffs, bushy vegetation, vineyards and Mediterranean buildings.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Bilingual signs in Italian appear in the far west.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Green house numbers and occasionally green street signs are typical of the capital.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Street signs with a blue shield and three yellow stars belong to Celje.
